tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create empty site; seeds brief. Globally taken slugs auto-suffix to `{slug}-{adjective}-{noun}` (default); pass onSlugTaken:"fail" to get a 409 instead of a renamed site.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Site detail, stats, publicUrl, brief head (default-on), and readiness flags. pages[] is a ~25-entry head by default (stats.pages has the true count); pass pages: true for the full array (capped at 1000), or list_content/get_site_manifest. Large sites (200+ pages): list_pages is paginated (cursor) or

tools.name: update_brief
tools.description: Update `_intent/site.md` (site brief) or a page brief when `page` is set. See field descriptions for rules, notes, and head enums.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Read-only workspace plan and pooled usage; pass slug for this site's add-ons. Call before a large build.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Read-only traffic overview (default) or full breakdowns via include[]; optional bot id for crawler page drill-down.

tools.name: set_analytics_provider
tools.description: Connect a third-party analytics provider (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, Umami) or remove it (provider 'none'). dotsy adds the provider's script to the <head> of every live page — live immediately, no publish needed. Replaces any earlier provider (one per site). Use this instead of pasting a GA4 gtag snipp

tools.name: get_custom_code
tools.description: Read the site-wide custom code: `draft` (what the next publish puts live) and `published` (what visitors get now) for both boxes — head (before </head>) and body (before </body>) — plus `pending`, `runOn` and `maxChars`.

tools.name: set_custom_code
tools.description: Set site-wide custom code: `head` goes before </head> and `body` before </body> on every page, on every layout. It is saved as a draft and goes live with the next publish_site (on a live-mode site the dashboard publishes only the code). It never runs in the editor. Up to 20,000 characters per box, s

tools.name: set_site_icon
tools.description: Set the favicon from a square image asset. Draft until publish.

tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Update site settings: title, keyConvention, or editingMode ('live' = each editor save publishes immediately; 'staged' = saves stay drafts until publish_site). Slug is the hostname — change it with rename_site, not this tool. Set 'staged' before handing the editor to a person via start_edit_session's

tools.name: rename_site
tools.description: Rename the site slug (hostname {slug}.dotsy.site). Owner-only; use the returned slug afterwards. Published site: the old slug redirects on the API (301 reads, 308 writes) and the old host 301s, both reserved until delete or rename-back. Never published: the old slug 404s and its hostname is released

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Publish draft to live. handoff required; feedback optional. Warnings (form_unwired, store, SEO) are advisory: tell the user. Site-check errors return a publish_issues decision. A request to publish is not agreement to publish those errors: use its publishWithIssues code only after the user has seen

tools.name: get_site_tasks
tools.description: What needs fixing on a site, from stored checks. Call after writes, before publish_site.

tools.name: get_draft_status
tools.description: Pending draft changes: content keys and routes with status. May include requiredDecision (publish_confirm) before publish_site.

tools.name: review_changes
tools.description: Review queue: what changed and isn't live yet. list (counts first) → get one item (hidden changes, optional diff, bodyChanged: false means only title/meta/route fields changed — review hidden, not the visible page) → mark_ready / unmark (≤50 ids). Then publish_site onlyReady:true. Drafts-only sites:

tools.name: discard_drafts
tools.description: Discard unpublished drafts: all (omit key/keys/routes/menus), one content key (key), menu draft only (menus:true), or a selection (keys, routes). Destructive — check get_draft_status first.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Permanently delete site; confirmSlug must equal slug.

tools.name: bulk_put_content
tools.description: Stage many content keys (pages, layouts, fragments). Content only — not routes or assets. Each body ≤60KB and the whole call ≤80KB; larger pages use stage_content_chunk, dotsy push, or PUT content-raw. May queue above the inline threshold.

tools.name: get_site_manifest
tools.description: Content keys + hashes only (optional routes=true) — static files live in list_assets, not manifest. Diff keys+hashes before apply_changeset; stage only changed bodies.

tools.name: find_replace
tools.description: Case-insensitive find→replace across pages in one staged commit. Batch all replacements into ONE call — never parallelize find_replace on the same key (concurrent edits surface as per-key conflict). find/replace ≤60KB.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Find pages containing a phrase (grep without reading bodies). Requires do-sqlite — graduate_site first if search_unavailable.

tools.name: graduate_site
tools.description: Enable site search & collections (kv → do-sqlite), one-way. Unlocks search_content, collection indexes, visitor /__paige/search, and moves any R2 form-submission ledger into SiteDb. 409 blocked: `reason` names the gate — unsupported source backend (never overridable); strictDrafts (default true; str

tools.name: apply_changeset
tools.description: Stage writes[] + deletes[] in one call; attach routes via writes[].route. writes[].ifMatch (hash from get_site_manifest; "" = must not exist) guards each key (a delete takes { key, ifMatch } too); atomic:true makes one stale key write nothing (409 changeset_conflict). At most 10 writes; each body ≤6

tools.name: import_site_from_url
tools.description: Import URL to draft. On complete, response may include requiredDecision — preview then ask mirror vs editable before structure_*.

tools.name: get_structure_status
tools.description: Flat vs structured page counts; chromeCoverage = real per-fragment page counts + missedPages (check before promising sitewide edits). Informs user — do not auto-run analyze/apply while requiredDecision pending.

tools.name: structure_site_analyze
tools.description: Propose shared layout + fragments; persist:false first. Wait for mirror-vs-editable answer if requiredDecision pending.

tools.name: structure_site_apply
tools.description: Rewrite flat pages to layout + fragments (draft). Do not call while requiredDecision pending — user must pick editable first. It extracts header/footer only; report chromeCoverage counts, not 'sitewide'. Afterwards share_section with no arguments lists the other repeated blocks (banner, CTA).

tools.name: get_structure_result
tools.description: Last structure apply job result (structuredKeys, conflicts, partial).

tools.name: adapt_site_analyze
tools.description: Propose nav wiring + blog collectionization for an imported mirror (draft, opt-in). Read-only; returns per-adapter reports + proposalEtag. Nav decline may include nextStep (e.g. mega-menu → edit fragments/header.html). Wait for mirror-vs-editable answer if requiredDecision pending.

tools.name: adapt_site_apply
tools.description: Apply the adapt proposal (draft): wire nav into the menu store and/or rewrite the blog index to a live <dotsy-collection>. One undo covers the whole apply; a second apply is refused until adapt_site_revert (or force). Queued applies are polled to completion.

tools.name: adapt_site_revert
tools.description: Atomically restore everything the last adapt_site_apply wrote (fragments, the menu doc when the op touched it, index, member configs, routes).

tools.name: get_adapt_status
tools.description: Read adapt state: proposal summary + proposalEtag (+ applied/consumed flag), undo-record presence, active or queued job progress. Use to resume in a fresh session.

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: List content keys (HTML/md); not assets — use list_assets. Defaults to 50 keys per page: raise limit (max 1000) or pass cursor (nextCursor). Per-row `size`/`missing` are measured only on pages of ≤100 rows; past that they're ABSENT (never `null`) unless you pass withSize:true (one storage read per r

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Read one content key; optional selector (region) or published=true (live body). Bodies over 40KB without a selector return a truncated summary — use selector, batch_patch_content, or dotsy pull.

tools.name: put_content
tools.description: Stage one content key. Body ≤60KB. Larger pages: stage_content_chunk + apply_changeset bodyStaging, dotsy push, or PUT content-raw. Edits to an existing large page: batch_patch_content.

tools.name: stage_content_chunk
tools.description: Append one ≤60KB chunk of a large new page. Omit stagingId on seq 0; pass the returned stagingId on later seq. Set finalize:true on the last chunk, then apply_changeset with writes[].bodyStaging.

tools.name: patch_content
tools.description: Edit one content key via ops[] (selector ops or replace-string; wrap/unwrap/move restructure siblings). Stages draft; op shapes in schema.

tools.name: batch_patch_content
tools.description: patch_content on multiple keys; all-or-nothing validation. Preferred edit path for pages over 60KB. replace-string value/replace ≤60KB; whole call ≤80KB.

tools.name: delete_content
tools.description: Delete content key (tombstone if published). A fragments/* section that pages still place is refused with section_in_use (lists the pages) — detach it or remove it first.

tools.name: rename_content
tools.description: Re-key a page by slug (draft or published static), server-side hash copy. tools.name: put_post
tools.description: Stage a blog post via structured meta+body (?format=post). Key e.g. blog/my-post.html. Declared membership: meta.collections; schedule: meta.visibleAt; SEO title override: meta.seoTitle (card always shows meta.title); custom fields: meta.custom (typed per collection by get_collection_schema; the res

tools.name: inspect_collection
tools.description: Collection state — count, server.mode, sample entries, tag (membershipKind, match=) when discovered; plus name, noun, URL pattern, layout, where it's listed, and post fields used. Pass status/q/cursor/limit (any one, even empty) for a full items[] page instead: status draft = never published; a publ

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Collections on the site — name, noun, item count (or 'not published yet'), URL pattern, and whether any member is staged. Includes a collection only a draft page lists. Returns a bare array (not wrapped in an object) — pass each row's key verbatim to inspect_collection/update_collection.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Rename a collection's display name and/or noun (e.g. the generic 'posts' key shown as 'Recipes' / 'recipe') — cosmetic only, stored separately from the tag that defines membership; doesn't need publish. Provide at least one of name/noun. null (or "") resets that field back to its derived default — d

tools.name: new_post_template
tools.description: Read-only scaffold for a new post — suggested key/path, membership meta, blank or duplicate body. Then put_post (+ optional put_route).

tools.name: get_collection_schema
tools.description: Read the site's collection field definitions (`_data/collections.json`, draft view): { schema: { v: 1, collections: { "<key>": { fields[], settings? } } }, hash }. hash is null when no schema exists yet — pass it as put_collection_schema ifMatch. 409 collection_schema_invalid { hash, issues } means

tools.name: put_collection_schema
tools.description: Replace the whole field schema (draft; publish makes it live). Edit what get_collection_schema returns. Collection keys exactly as list_collections returns them ("blog/" or an id). Field: { key, type, label?, help?, required?, unique?, inCard?, default? } — type text (multiline, minLength, maxLength

tools.name: set_item_status
tools.description: Change a roadmap/board item status (stamps dates; on release drafts the changelog post and links both ways). Never hand-edit *At, daysToRelease, or votes.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: List board items with status, stamp fields, and baked vote counts (draft overlay included). Live vote totals: site host GET /__dotsy/votes.

tools.name: list_votes
tools.description: List voters on one board item (voter id + source only — no email).

tools.name: remove_votes
tools.description: Remove one voter's vote and drop their release subscription for that item.

tools.name: list_suggestions
tools.description: List form suggestions awaiting moderation (duplicate hints against the board).

tools.name: moderate_suggestion
tools.description: Decide one form suggestion from list_suggestions: approve (new draft board item; stages content, does not publish), merge (into an existing board item, subscribes the voter/email) or decline (no board item).

tools.name: add_idea
tools.description: Add an idea from outside the site (draft board item or inbox suggestion). Idempotent on externalRef.

tools.name: list_ideas
tools.description: Search draft/published board items and open suggestions by title token overlap.

tools.name: infer_collection_schema
tools.description: Suggest fields for one collection from a sample of its items' meta.custom values (published data, else drafts) — writes nothing. Returns { sampled, suggestions: [{ field: { key, type, options? }, count, samples, defined }], skipped }. Review, then add the ones you want via put_collection_schema.

tools.name: reindex_collection
tools.description: Build/finish collection indexes after publish returns collectionDataPending or collectionSqlPending.

tools.name: preview_page
tools.description: Verify-only composed HTML check; home preview may include requiredDecision — ask mirror vs editable before structure_*.

tools.name: verify_page
tools.description: Pre-publish lint (tags, assets, layout, SEO, speed and accessibility). Summary first: health issues grouped by code, each with fix:{tool,args,fill?} — supply the fill args, then call. health.summary counts are whole-site (groups/codes filter only issues and assets). Pair with preview_page — see get_

tools.name: preflight_site
tools.description: Plan check before publish or large build (counts, plan page cap, seo suggestions; imports: form_unwired advisory, webflow_store blocking). When ok is false, blocking lists the failed suggestion codes. Read-only.

tools.name: start_edit_session
tools.description: Open a draft session. Returns preview/edit URLs for the person (see linkGuidance). draftEditorUrl only when the site gives AI agents Full access. path defaults to '/'.

tools.name: get_site_outline
tools.description: Site shape: every layout and shared section (`sections`: fragments/* by name, with page count, whether the file exists and staged-change flag), whether a layout is missing, redirects count, menus grouped by where they show, and collections with their page placements. Use for 'is my layout missing',

tools.name: share_section
tools.description: Make a block that repeats on several pages one shared section, or change where one shows. tools.name: detach_section
tools.description: Give one page its own copy of a shared section; every other page keeps the shared one. A draft — publish_site to go live. A section the layout places is hidden on that page instead (share_section name + hide).

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Get one route by path (home is '/').

tools.name: put_route
tools.description: Create/replace route; contentKey derived from path if omitted. On a field that accepts null (contentKey, redirectTo, redirectStatus, preserveQuery), sending null clears it back to its default.

tools.name: patch_route
tools.description: Partial route update (only sent fields change; an OMITTED field is left alone). On a field that accepts null (contentKey, redirectTo, redirectStatus, preserveQuery), sending null CLEARS it back to its default — different from omitting it. To set redirectTo/redirectStatus, include purpose: "redirect"

tools.name: rename_page
tools.description: Change a page's URL: moves its route from `from` to `to`. Menu links and redirects to the old path retarget automatically; a 301 stays at the old path by default (leaveRedirect). Root-relative and https://{slug}.dotsy.site/ hrefs in draft page, layout and fragment HTML are rewritten (always linksRew

tools.name: delete_route
tools.description: Remove a route by path.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: List site conversion goals (pageview paths and form submits). Required before start_test.

tools.name: put_goals
tools.description: Create or replace all site conversion goals (≤50). Required before start_test when no goal exists.

tools.name: estimate_test
tools.description: Estimate days to reach promote readiness for a page (traffic baseline). Read-only.

tools.name: start_test
tools.description: Start a same-URL A/B test (draft or live source). Rules → get_skill('verify') § A/B.

tools.name: promote_experiment
tools.description: Promote a winning A/B variant to live — explicit user instruction only; see get_skill('verify') § A/B.

tools.name: delete_draft_test
tools.description: Remove a draft A/B test (releases variant bodies; does not publish).

tools.name: set_experiment_note
tools.description: Record what was learned from an ended A/B test (≤500 chars; null clears).

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Read a menu's draft items and etag; menu rules → get_skill('nav').

tools.name: put_menu_item
tools.description: Partial upsert one menu item: send only the fields to change; every omitted field (parent, sort, label, kind, ref, newTab, html/childTemplate/childShell/attrs/data) keeps its stored value, and parent: null moves it to the top level. A new id needs label, kind and ref (parent defaults to null, sort t

tools.name: delete_menu_item
tools.description: Remove one item from a menu (page stays live).

tools.name: reorder_menu
tools.description: Set final menu order. Pass ifMatch from get_menu; stale → 409 with current items.

tools.name: get_menu_doc
tools.description: Read the whole menu doc (all menus + shell/template), etag for put_menu_doc, and issues (by item id) — page_not_routable, page_missing, page_dead_link, page_is_redirect — computed from the draft routes, so a link that won't show or leads nowhere shows up before publish.

tools.name: put_menu_doc
tools.description: Replace the whole menu doc (ifMatch from get_menu_doc required). Each item may omit menu — the enclosing menu key in doc is used.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: CMS uploads under assets/ only — not mirrored clone CDN (get_site mirroredAssets or import warmJob). Not content — use list_content. Live in the editor and draft preview at once; on the published site after the next publish.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Read one asset (metadata + base64 + stored sha256). sha256 is the stored blob; may differ from upload bodySha256 when IMAGES re-encodes rasters. Live in the editor and draft preview at once; on the published site after the next publish.

tools.name: bulk_put_assets
tools.description: Upload 1–200 CMS assets; key = path after /assets/, or sitePath for an exact URL path (e.g. /.well-known/security.txt, /ads.txt). Each item: exactly one of bodyBase64, bodyText (plain text for .css/.js/.mjs/.json/.svg/.txt/.xml only — not .html pages), or importFromUrl. Optional bodySha256 checks th

tools.name: delete_asset
tools.description: Delete a static asset by key. The editor and draft preview drop it at once; the published site drops it at the next publish.

tools.name: optimize_assets
tools.description: Shrink heavy images in place (0.98): JPEG/PNG/still GIF → WebP at the same address, so no HTML changes. keys = site paths from verify_page health.assets[].ref — /assets/… uploads or clone paths like /wp-content/… (1–50 per call; batch keys from several entries). Skips animated images, already-small

tools.name: start_site
tools.description: Start one draft site with no dotsy account. Returns slug + guestToken — pass guestToken on every later tool call until claim_site.

tools.name: claim_site
tools.description: Move the guest draft onto your signed-in dotsy account. Requires OAuth Connect; pass the guestToken from start_site.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Paige build skills (id + whenToUse). Pull get_skill on demand — do not duplicate in tool text.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Skill body + optional questions[]. Accepts an id OR a synonym (e.g. 'list', 'menu') — resolves aliases and suggests near-misses. Start with intake when ambiguous.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Optional mid-session feedback (required feedback rides with publish_site).

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: List site activity or fetch one change diff (pass id). Filters: who, state, actor (me), since, limit≤20. Notes from context are visible to everyone on the site — no secrets.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the site's published versions, newest first (who, when, pages, live, restorable). Use before restore_version.

tools.name: restore_version

Then review and publish_site, or discard_drafts to undo; publish:true makes it live at on

tools.name: undo_publish
tools.description: Take back the last publish at once: restores the previous version of the pages it changed and publishes them; the undone changes stay as unpublished changes (`restaged`). tools.name: revert_change
tools.description: Undo one activity event by staging the prior version as draft only — call publish_site to go live. Respects AI access.

tools.name: get_account_context
tools.description: Account, user, memberships[]. Pass workspace on writes when memberships.length > 1.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a dotsy bug, or ask a support question (kind question — AI answer from the help centre). Bugs attach recent errors and return a ticket id.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Your dotsy bug reports. Omit id for the list; pass id for one ticket and its public replies.

tools.name: reply_to_report
tools.description: Add information or answer dotsy's question on your own report.

tools.name: add_custom_domain
tools.description: Connect apex and/or www on a paid plan; starts a DNS connect session.

tools.name: get_custom_domain_connect
tools.description: Current connect session and nextAction (browser URL or manual DNS guide).

tools.name: reapply_custom_domain_oauth
tools.description: Re-apply DNS with stored Cloudflare OAuth grant (no browser).

tools.name: refresh_custom_domain
tools.description: Poll one hostname until DNS/cert propagates.

tools.name: wait_for_custom_domain
tools.description: Poll one hostname until it is connected or the timeout is reached.

tools.name: set_primary_custom_domain
tools.description: Set the canonical host (301 target).

tools.name: list_custom_domains
tools.description: List all custom hostnames and connection status for the site. A connected bare domain with redirectorState "attention" is NOT redirecting (see `attention`).

tools.name: remove_custom_domain
tools.description: Remove one custom hostname from the site.

tools.name: list_form_submissions
tools.description: List form submissions (metadata + bounded field preview — not full PII). Works on kv and do-sqlite backends.

tools.name: form_recipients
tools.description: Who a site's forms may email. A form's `to` address gets submissions only when it is a verified site member or it confirmed by a one-click link we email it (no account, no sign-in, no site access). action: `list` (confirmed + waiting addresses), `status` (one address: member | confirmed | pending |

tools.name: get_form_submission
tools.description: Read one form submission with the full field payload (explicit PII access — use only when needed).

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: Account notification inbox (Needs you · Updates). Summary-first: tab counts plus compact rows with nextAction (MCP tool or dashboard URL). OAuth person only — not API keys.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark Update notifications read (ids or all). Needs-you Actions refuse with 422 action_not_markable — fix the cause (it clears itself); only the person can dismiss them in the dashboard.

tools.name: list_my_sites
tools.description: List your dotsy sites. Renders a site-picker for humans; agent reads structuredContent. Use to choose a site — not for editing content (use edit_page) or verify-only checks (use preview_page). Defaults to your active workspace; pass workspace (org id or slug from get_account_context memberships) to

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List pages on a site — route settings (path/title/navLabel/purpose) by default, one row per route. Use after picking a site — not for editing (use edit_page) or

tools.name: edit_page
tools.description: Open the interactive page canvas to change content: the user clicks an element, then you call patch_content. Use when the intent is editing — not for verify-only checks (use preview_page).

tools.name: get_site_build_progress
tools.description: Read-only build progress view  (structure/adapt jobs or after import). structuredContent.forHumans holds the headline and progress. import_site_from_url blocks until done, so this is not needed during an import; get_site has the full state.
